question_text: Wetin be National Identification Number (NIN)?
alt_questions: Wetin be NIN?
Wetin NIN mean?
Wetin be NIN sef?
Why I need NIN?
Wetin NIN dey do?
Explain NIN give me
Wetin NIMC dey do?
answer_text: National Identification Number (NIN) na one special 11-digit number wey National Identity Management Commission (NIMC) dey give every citizen and legal resident after dem don enrol you for National Identity Database. Dem dey give am once and e go follow you for life. You go need NIN to confirm say na you for things like SIM registration, passport application, driver's licence application, BVN linkage for bank, JAMB registration and government programmes.

question_text: Who fit enrol for NIN?
alt_questions: Who fit do NIN?
Pikin fit get NIN?
Foreigner fit get NIN?
My pikin fit do NIN?
How old person suppose be before e do NIN?
answer_text: All Nigerian citizens and legal residents for Nigeria fit enrol for NIN, from the day dem born am. Dem fit enrol pikin and minor; if the pikin never reach 16, parent or guardian must dey there, and dem go link the parent or guardian own NIN to the pikin record. Legal residents (foreigners wey get correct immigration status) go enrol with their valid immigration documents.

question_text: How I go take enrol for NIN?
alt_questions: Abeg how I go take get NIN?
How person fit get NIN?
How I go do NIN registration?
Wetin be the steps for NIN?
How I go register for NIN?
I wan do NIN, how?
Where I go start for NIN?
answer_text: To enrol for NIN: 1) Go NIMC enrolment centre or NIMC-licensed Front End Partner (enrolment agent) wey dey near you. 2) Fill the enrolment form (you fit pre-enrol online for NIMC portal make e quick). 3) Show one correct supporting document (like birth certificate, voter's card, driver's licence, international passport or declaration of age). 4) Dem go capture your biometrics (ten fingerprints, face photo and signature). 5) Dem go give you transaction slip; dem go issue your NIN after processing (many times inside few days) and you fit check am if you dial *346# with the phone number wey you register. The enrolment itself na free.

question_text: Wetin I need carry go for NIN enrolment?
alt_questions: Wetin I need to carry go NIMC office?
Which document I go bring for NIN?
Wetin dem dey ask for NIN registration?
NIN requirement na wetin?
Which paper I need for NIN?
answer_text: You need only ONE correct supporting document for NIN enrolment. Documents wey dem dey accept: birth certificate or declaration of age; voter's card (temporary or permanent); Nigerian international passport; driver's licence; certificate of origin; attestation letter from traditional ruler or religious leader wey dem recognise; government or registered-company staff ID card; school ID card; tax clearance certificate; NHIS card; or valid immigration documents for legal residents. Carry the original go the enrolment centre.

question_text: How much NIN enrolment dey cost?
alt_questions: Dem dey collect money for NIN?
NIN na free?
How much be NIN?
Person go pay for NIN?
E free?
How much dem dey charge for NIN registration?
answer_text: NIN enrolment and your first NIN slip na FREE for NIMC enrolment centres and licensed partners. NIMC don warn people say make dem no pay anybody for normal enrolment. The only enrolment wey you go pay for na the optional premium (VIP) service for licensed lounges and visa application centres, wey NIMC May 2025 fee schedule put for ₦20,000. If anybody dey demand money for normal enrolment, report am give NIMC.

question_text: How I go check or recover my NIN?
alt_questions: I forget my NIN, how I go check am?
How I go see my NIN?
Which code I go dial for NIN?
My NIN don loss for my head, how I go find am?
How to check NIN for phone?
answer_text: To recover your NIN, dial *346# with the phone number wey you use do enrolment, choose 'NIN Retrieval' and follow the prompts; your NIN go show for screen. The network go charge small airtime (about ₦20) for the USSD. You fit also see your NIN for NINAuth mobile app after you confirm say na you. If the phone number wey you register don loss, you go first update your phone number through NIMC self-service modification.

question_text: How I go get or reprint my NIN slip?
alt_questions: How I go print my NIN slip?
My NIN slip don loss
How much be NIN slip reprint?
Where I go collect NIN slip?
I need new NIN slip
answer_text: Dem dey give your first NIN slip free during enrolment. To replace (re-issue) the standard NIN slip na ₦600 for NIMC May 2025 fee schedule (₦3,500 for premium/VIP slip). You fit get the improved digital NIN slip from NIMC self-service portal or NINAuth app and print am yourself; plenty enrolment centres and licensed agents fit also print am for the official fee. Keep the slip or digital copy because many services dey ask for am.

question_text: How I go correct or change my NIN details (name, date of birth, address, phone)?
alt_questions: How I go change my name for NIN?
My date of birth for NIN no correct, wetin I go do?
How to do NIN modification?
Dem spell my name wrong for NIN
How I go change phone number for NIN?
answer_text: Dem dey modify NIN record for NIMC Self-Service Modification portal (selfservicemodification.nimc.gov.ng) or if you dial *346# and choose 'NIN Modification'; NIMC talk for 2024 say dem no dey do normal modification for enrolment centres again. Steps for the portal: 1) Register or log in with your NIN. 2) Choose wetin you wan change (name, date of birth, address, phone number). 3) Pay the official fee online. 4) Upload your supporting documents (for date of birth, put your NPC birth certificate or attestation number; the date go fill by itself). 5) Check am well, tick the attestation and submit. 6) Keep the transaction slip; dem go email the updated NIN slip give you and you fit print am from your dashboard. Small changes dey usually finish inside one or two days; name and date-of-birth changes fit take reach about two weeks.

question_text: How much e cost to change my NIN details?
alt_questions: I wan change my name for NIN, how much?
How much be NIN date of birth correction?
How much dem dey collect for NIN modification?
NIN correction na how much?
answer_text: For NIMC fee schedule wey dem publish for May 2025: to correct date of birth na ₦28,574; to change name, address, phone number or other data na ₦2,000 per request; re-issue of standard NIN slip na ₦600. For Nigerians wey dey abroad, date-of-birth correction na $55 (Africa) or $60 (outside Africa) and other modifications na $10. Na only online for the self-service portal you go pay; the amount wey show for the official portal when you dey pay na im be the correct one.

question_text: Wetin I need to change my name or date of birth for my NIN?
alt_questions: Which document I need for NIN date of birth change?
Wetin I go upload to change my name for NIN?
Wetin dem need for NIN correction?
answer_text: Date of birth: digitised NPC birth certificate (for people wey dem born from 1992) or digitised NPC attestation of birth (for people wey dem born before); if you no get any of them, first do online birth attestation with National Population Commission. Name: court affidavit, newspaper publication of the change, marriage certificate if na marriage cause am, and another government ID. Address: recent utility bill, tenancy agreement or attestation letter. Phone number: you must fit use the new number for verification; dem fit ask for police report if the phone wey dem link don loss or dem steal am.

question_text: Where dem dey require NIN?
alt_questions: Wetin I fit use NIN do?
Why NIN dey important?
Which places dem dey ask for NIN?
I need NIN for bank?
answer_text: NIN na must for: to register or keep your SIM active (NIN-SIM linkage); to apply or renew international passport; to apply for National Driver's Licence; to link your bank accounts (NIN-BVN linkage); JAMB and other exam registration; National Health Insurance; pension and payroll verification; and plenty other government and money services. Keep your NIN slip or digital slip handy.

question_text: Wetin be NINAuth app and wetin I fit do with am?
alt_questions: Wetin NINAuth dey do?
How NINAuth app dey work?
NINAuth na wetin?
answer_text: NINAuth na NIMC digital identity app. After you confirm say na you with your NIN and phone number, you fit see your NIN, open your digital NIN slip, and approve or reject when any organisation wan verify your identity, so na you dey control who see your data. Download am only from the official app stores and no give anybody your login code.

question_text: Agent fit get my NIN quick if I pay?
alt_questions: Make I pay agent make e do my NIN fast?
Somebody say e fit do my NIN sharp sharp for money
Na scam?
Agent dey collect money for NIN, e correct?
answer_text: No. Normal NIN enrolment na free and nobody fit legally 'fast-track' am for money. Use only NIMC enrolment centres or NIMC-licensed Front End Partners, type the official portal address yourself instead of to click link wey dem send, and no share your NIN slip, OTP codes or NINAuth login with anybody wey you no trust. Report anybody wey dey demand money wey no be official give NIMC through their official channels.

question_text: Which types of Nigerian passport dey?
alt_questions: How many types of passport dey?
Which passport I go take?
Difference between 32 page and 64 page passport
Wetin be green passport?
answer_text: Nigeria dey issue three types: Standard (green) passport for all citizens, wey get 32-page 5-year booklet, 64-page 5-year booklet and 64-page 10-year booklet; Official (blue) passport for government officials of certain ranks; and Diplomatic passport for diplomats and top officials wey the President approve. The current enhanced e-passport na polycarbonate booklet wey get stronger security, and the 64-page booklet get 10-year validity.

question_text: How much Nigerian passport cost?
alt_questions: How much be passport now?
How much passport dey cost?
Passport price na how much?
How much I go pay for passport?
How much dem dey collect for international passport?
answer_text: For people wey dey apply for Nigeria, the fees wey start from 1 September 2025 na: 32-page booklet with 5-year validity ₦100,000; 64-page booklet with 10-year validity ₦200,000. The 64-page 5-year booklet dey for NIS site; confirm the current price for the portal when you dey apply. For Nigerians wey dey apply from abroad, the fees still be $150 (32-page, 5 years) and $230 (64-page, 10 years). Na strictly online you go pay through the official portal; the fee wey show for portal when you dey pay na im apply.

question_text: How I go apply for new Nigerian passport?
alt_questions: How I go take get passport?
How person fit do international passport?
I never get passport before, how I go start?
Steps for passport abeg
I wan do passport
answer_text: To apply for new Standard passport: 1) Go passport.immigration.gov.ng (type am yourself) and fill the online application form. 2) Upload your NPC birth certificate or High Court age declaration, your state-of-origin or LGA identification letter, and pay online. 3) Book appointment date for the passport office wey you choose. 4) Go there yourself on the appointment date with your payment slip, appointment slip and original documents for biometric capture (fingerprints, photo, signature). 5) Track your application for the portal and collect your passport when e ready. People wey dey outside Nigeria go use passportintl.immigration.gov.ng and the Nigerian embassy or high commission wey near dem.

question_text: Wetin I need for Nigerian passport application?
alt_questions: Abeg which documents I need for passport?
Wetin I go carry go immigration?
Passport requirement na wetin?
Which paper dem need for passport?
answer_text: For adult citizen by birth: valid NIN (dem dey link passport record to your NIN); NPC birth certificate (compulsory for people wey dem born from December 1992) or age declaration wey you swear before Commissioner for Oaths; letter of identification from your Local Government Area or state of origin, or national identity card; two passport photographs; guarantor's form wey dem fill and sign before Commissioner for Oaths, with photocopy of the guarantor passport data page and one photo of the guarantor; marriage certificate if e concern you; and your acknowledgement slip and proof of payment.

question_text: How I go get passport for my pikin?
alt_questions: Passport for my pikin
How to do passport for small pikin?
My child wan get passport
Wetin I need for my pikin passport?
answer_text: For minor (under 18): fill the online application; upload the pikin NPC birth certificate; show evidence say the parents na Nigerians (like parent passport data page); consent letter from one parent; one photo of the pikin wey the consenting parent endorse; and the acknowledgement slip and proof of payment. The pikin must go the passport office with the parent for capture. Adopted pikin go also need court adoption order and approval from State Ministry of Women Affairs.

question_text: How I go renew my Nigerian passport?
alt_questions: My passport don expire, how I go renew am?
How to renew passport?
Passport renewal steps
My passport pages don finish
answer_text: Renewal (re-issue) na the same online process like new application: 1) Apply for passport.immigration.gov.ng, choose renewal, and upload your birth certificate or age declaration, state-of-origin letter and data page of your current passport. 2) Pay online and book appointment. 3) Carry the old passport booklet go passport office on your appointment date for photo and biometric capture. Note the NIS rule: if your passport remain less than six months, dem go treat am like say e don expire for travel, so renew early. The fees na the same with new booklet.

question_text: How I go change my name or correct mistake for my passport?
alt_questions: Dem spell my name wrong for passport
How I go change my surname for passport after marriage?
Correct date of birth for passport
answer_text: Apply online for 'change of data' and pay administrative charge wey dem no dey refund. Depending on your case, you go upload application letter, court affidavit, newspaper publication of the name change, your state-of-origin letter, birth certificate or age declaration, and your passport data page; if na marriage name change, upload your marriage certificate too. Name replacement, addition, removal or rearrangement na through the change-details service for NIS portal. After that you must go passport office with your current booklet for biometric capture.

question_text: How long e dey take to get Nigerian passport?
alt_questions: How long passport dey take?
When my passport go ready?
How many weeks passport dey take?
Passport never ready, wetin I go do?
How I go track my passport?
answer_text: NIS no publish any guaranteed time; for the automated e-passport system, production dey usually take about two to six weeks after successful biometric capture, depending on the office and if booklet dey. The portal document-management system go make you track your application, and dem go tell you when the passport ready for collection for the office where dem capture you. Appointment for busy offices (Lagos, Abuja, Kano) fit be some weeks away, so apply early.

question_text: Where I fit apply for passport?
alt_questions: Which office I go for passport?
Passport office dey my state?
Where immigration office dey?
I dey abroad, where I go do passport?
answer_text: Application dey start online for passport.immigration.gov.ng, where you go choose any NIS passport office for Nigeria for your biometric capture appointment (no be only your state of origin). Passport offices dey all 36 states and FCT. Nigerians wey dey abroad go apply through passportintl.immigration.gov.ng and go the Nigerian embassy, high commission or consulate wey near dem. NIS contact: +234-912-1900-655, nis.servicom@nigeriaimmigration.gov.ng.

question_text: Make I use agent make my passport come quick?
alt_questions: Agent fit do my passport fast?
Make I pay tout for passport?
Somebody say e fit help me run passport quick quick
answer_text: NIS automate passport issuance to remove middlemen and touts. Pay only for the official portal, type the address yourself, and go your appointment by yourself. Nobody fit legally issue passport outside the official process, and if you pay tout you fit fall for fraud or get passport record wey dem go flag later. Use the official helpline (+234-912-1900-655) if your application get wahala.

question_text: Wetin be National Driver's Licence and who dey issue am?
alt_questions: Na FRSC dey give driver licence?
Who dey do driver licence?
Wetin be driver licence class?
Which agency dey give licence?
answer_text: Dem dey issue National Driver's Licence under scheme wey Federal Road Safety Corps (FRSC) dey run together with Joint Tax Board and the state Motor Vehicle Administration offices (Board of Internal Revenue / VIO). Application na for the official portal nigeriadriverslicence.frsc.gov.ng (the old address nigeriadriverslicence.org go carry you go there). Licence get classes; new applicants fit apply for up to two classes, A (motorcycle/tricycle) and B (private motor vehicle). Commercial classes na for capture centre dem dey process am, no be from the portal home page.

question_text: How I go apply for new driver's licence?
alt_questions: How I go take get driver licence?
How person fit do driver licence?
I wan get licence, wetin I go do?
Steps for driver licence
answer_text: 1) Do the compulsory training for FRSC-accredited driving school and collect your driving school certificate number. 2) Go nigeriadriverslicence.frsc.gov.ng, open 'DL Application' and choose 'New Driver's Licence'. 3) Put your certificate number, fill your personal details (you need valid NIN), choose your licence class(es) and validity (3 or 5 years) and answer 'No' say you never get licence before. 4) Pay online by card, for bank, by POS for licence centre or through eWallet. 5) Go Processing/Capture Centre by yourself (find one under Contact > Capture Centre by state and LGA) for biometric capture and your driving test with Vehicle Inspection Officer. 6) Dem go give you temporary licence; track the permanent card under 'Track DL Application Status' and collect am when e ready.

question_text: Wetin be the requirements for driver's licence?
alt_questions: Wetin I need for driver licence?
How old I suppose be for driver licence?
I need driving school before licence?
Wetin dem dey ask for licence?
answer_text: You must reach at least 18 years; get valid National Identification Number (NIN); finish training for accredited driving school and get the certificate number; pass the written and practical driving tests for the capture centre; bring medical certificate of fitness (must for commercial classes); bring passport photographs; and pay the official fee. You must go the capture centre by yourself; nobody fit do your biometrics or submit photo for you.

question_text: How much driver's licence dey cost?
alt_questions: How much dem dey charge for drivers licence?
How much be driver licence now?
Driver licence price
How much I go pay for licence?
answer_text: The fees wey Joint Tax Board approve, wey start from 1 November 2024, na: motor vehicle classes (Class B and others) ₦15,000 for 3-year validity and ₦21,000 for 5-year validity; motorcycle and tricycle (Class A) ₦7,000 for 3 years and ₦11,000 for 5 years. Dem dey charge each class separately, and bank or card payment fit add small charges. Renewal cost the same as new licence of the same class and validity. Pay only through the official portal or the banks wey dem name; the amount wey show for portal when you dey pay na im apply.

question_text: How I go renew my driver's licence?
alt_questions: My licence don expire, how I go renew am?
Driver licence renewal steps
How to renew driver licence?
answer_text: Go nigeriadriverslicence.frsc.gov.ng, open 'DL Application' and choose 'Renewal of Driver's Licence'. Put your driver's licence number, confirm your details, choose 3-year or 5-year validity and pay online. Then go capture centre for new biometric capture (you no need new driving school training). If your licence don expire you must use Renewal; if e still valid but e loss or spoil, use Re-Issue. The renewed licence go dey valid till the new expiry date.

question_text: Wetin I go do if my driver's licence loss or dem steal am?
alt_questions: I don lose my driver licence, wetin I go do?
Dem steal my licence
My licence don loss
How I go replace my licence?
answer_text: If the licence still dey inside the validity period, go 'DL Application' > 'Re-Issue of Driver's Licence' for nigeriadriverslicence.frsc.gov.ng, put your licence number, pay and go capture centre. Police report good if dem steal the licence. If the licence wey loss don already expire, use Renewal instead. Upgrade (to add or remove class) na also through renewal or re-issue with your licence number; dem dey charge separately to add class.

question_text: How long driver's licence dey valid?
alt_questions: How long licence go last?
When licence dey expire?
Licence na for how many years?
answer_text: When you dey apply you go choose 3-year or 5-year validity. The fee depend on the validity and the licence class. Start renewal before the expiry date; to drive with expired licence na offence under FRSC regulations.

question_text: How I go track my driver's licence application or collect my card?
alt_questions: My licence never ready
Where I go collect my licence card?
How I go check my licence status?
answer_text: Use 'Track DL Application Status' for nigeriadriverslicence.frsc.gov.ng with your application ID or licence number and date of birth. You fit edit application only before payment, and dem dey delete applications wey nobody pay for after three months. You go collect the permanent card for Motor Vehicle Administration / licensing office wey connect to the capture centre wey you use; the temporary licence go cover you till then. For help call FRSC on 0700-2255-3772 or the toll-free emergency line 122.

question_text: How I go get commercial driver's licence?
alt_questions: Licence for danfo or trailer
Licence for truck driver
How to get licence for commercial vehicle?
Licence for okada or keke
answer_text: You no fit start commercial licence classes from the portal home page. Go capture centre by yourself with your driving school certificate and medical certificate of fitness; FRSC operator go start the application for you, then you go pay and finish biometric capture. Diplomatic licences na only for FRSC Headquarters for Abuja dem dey issue am, when you show documents wey confirm say you get diplomatic status.

question_text: Wetin be civil registration and who dey handle am for Nigeria?
alt_questions: Who dey do birth certificate?
Wetin NPC dey do?
Why birth certificate dey important?
answer_text: Civil registration na to dey record vital events all the time, compulsory and for everybody: births, deaths, stillbirths, marriages and related events. For Nigeria, National Population Commission (NPC) dey register births, deaths and stillbirths under Births, Deaths, Etc. (Compulsory Registration) Act No. 69 of 1992. NPC get about 4,000 registration centres across the 774 Local Government Areas, with at least four centres for each LGA. NPC birth certificate na the legal proof of age, parents and place of birth, and dem need am for passport, NIN date-of-birth records, school admission and more.

question_text: How I go register my pikin birth and get birth certificate?
alt_questions: Where I fit register my pikin birth?
How I go do birth certificate for my baby?
My wife just born, how we go register the pikin?
How to get birth certificate?
answer_text: By hand: carry the pikin (or hospital birth notification) go the NPC registration centre wey near you, wey dey often for Local Government secretariat, primary health centre or general hospital. The registrar go write the pikin name, date and place of birth and the parents details, and dem go give you NPC birth certificate. Online: parent wey get NIN fit open account for NPC Birth Registration Self-service portal (birthreg-selfservice.nationalpopulation.gov.ng, part of eCRVS system), do face verification, put the pikin and parents details, submit, track the application and download the certificate when dem approve am (you fit download am only once, so save am). Register as early as you fit; the law expect make una register birth within 60 days.

question_text: Wetin I need to register birth?
alt_questions: Wetin I go carry for birth registration?
Which document I need for birth certificate?
Wetin NPC dey ask for birth registration?
answer_text: Carry the hospital birth notification or immunisation card (or statement from traditional birth attendant or witness if na for house dem born the pikin), the parents ID (NIN slip, passport, voter's card or driver's licence), the parents marriage certificate if e dey, and the pikin full name, date and place of birth. For online self-service, the parent wey dey register need NIN, email address and phone or device wey get camera for face verification.

question_text: How much birth registration dey cost?
alt_questions: Birth certificate na free?
Dem dey collect money for birth certificate?
How much be birth certificate?
answer_text: Birth registration for pikin wey never reach five years na free for NPC registration centres. Some online self-service options, late registration and attestation services get official fees, wey go show for NPC portal before you pay; pay only through the official payment channel for the portal. If anybody for centre demand money to register pikin wey never reach five, ask for official receipt or report am give NPC.

question_text: I fit register birth late, or get birth certificate as adult?
alt_questions: I no get birth certificate, I don old
How adult go take get birth certificate?
My pikin don pass five years, e still fit register?
I never register my birth
answer_text: Yes. Make una register birth within 60 days, but NPC still dey register bigger children. Children wey never reach five na free; for older children and adults wey never register, NPC dey issue Attestation of Birth (some people dey call am birth attestation certificate) after you bring evidence like baptismal card, school record, sworn age declaration, parent ID or hospital records. You fit request attestation for registration centre or through NPC online portals, and e get official fee.

question_text: Wetin be the difference between birth certificate and attestation of birth?
alt_questions: Attestation and birth certificate na the same thing?
Which one I need, attestation or birth certificate?
answer_text: Dem dey issue birth certificate when dem register birth (better within 60 days and while the pikin still small) and na im be the main civil record. Attestation of Birth na document wey NPC dey give person wey dem no register im birth that time, based on evidence wey e bring later; e dey serve as proof of date and place of birth for passport, NIN modification and other things. NIS dey accept NPC birth certificate for people wey dem born from December 1992 and age declaration or NPC attestation for older people. For NIN date-of-birth correction, people wey dem born before 1992 go use attestation and people wey dem born after go use birth certificate.

question_text: I fit register birth or death online for Nigeria?
alt_questions: E dey possible to do birth registration for internet?
Birth certificate online
Which website for birth registration?
answer_text: Yes. NPC electronic Civil Registration and Vital Statistics (eCRVS) system start to work for whole country from July 2026 across all 36 states and FCT. Portals: birthreg-selfservice.nationalpopulation.gov.ng (birth registration self-service), ecrvs.nationalpopulation.gov.ng (eCRVS), and foreignbirth.nationalpopulation.gov.ng (notification of births abroad). You go open account with your name, email and NIN plus face verification, choose the service (birth or death registration, attestation, certificate re-issue where e dey), submit, track, and download the digital certificate. Always type the address yourself make you no enter fake site.

question_text: How I go register death and get death certificate?
alt_questions: My papa don die, how I go get death certificate?
How to register death?
Where dem dey do death certificate?
answer_text: Na National Population Commission dey register deaths. Carry the medical certificate of cause of death from the hospital (or statement from witness if the person die for house) and the person ID go the NPC registration centre wey near you, or use the death registration service for NPC online portal, where dem dey issue the certificate digitally where e apply. You go need death certificate for burial permit, inheritance, insurance and pension claims.

question_text: Wetin you fit help me with?
alt_questions: Wetin you fit do?
How you fit help me?
Wetin be Tambaya NG?
Who you be?
answer_text: Tambaya NG dey answer questions about four Nigerian public services with verified information from the agencies wey dey handle dem: National Identification Number (NIMC), international passport (Nigeria Immigration Service), National Driver's Licence (FRSC) and birth and civil registration (National Population Commission). You fit ask for English, Hausa, Yoruba, Igbo or Pidgin about requirements, documents, steps, fees and where to go, and every answer go show the official source. Na information and guidance I dey give; I no fit enrol you, issue document, collect payment or check your personal records, and I go show you the official channel when you need to take action.

question_text: You fit apply for passport or NIN for me?
alt_questions: You fit check my NIN for me?
Abeg help me register
You fit do am for me?
You be government?
answer_text: No. Tambaya NG na information and guidance assistant, e no be government portal. E no dey do transactions, e no fit enter any government database, e no dey verify identity, e no dey collect payment or approve application, and e no go ever ask for your NIN, passport number or other personal details. For any real application or transaction, use the official channel: nimc.gov.ng and *346# for NIN, passport.immigration.gov.ng for passport, nigeriadriverslicence.frsc.gov.ng for driver's licence and NPC registration centres or eCRVS portals for birth registration.

question_text: Wetin I go do if my passport loss or dem steal am?
alt_questions: I don lose my passport, wetin I go do?
Dem steal my passport
My passport don loss
How I go replace passport wey loss?
answer_text: If your Nigerian passport loss or dem steal am: 1) Report am for police quick and collect police report wey get your passport number. 2) Find copy of the passport data page, or at least the passport number and date of issue. 3) Write application letter to Comptroller General of Immigration (or apply online for passport.immigration.gov.ng), with the police report, data page copy and two passport photographs, and pay the official fee for the portal. 4) NIS Headquarters for Abuja go review am and approve before dem issue new booklet, then dem go call you to come for biometric capture by yourself. If you dey abroad and you need to travel go back Nigeria urgently, the Nigerian embassy or high commission fit issue Emergency Travel Certificate. Keep the police report because your old passport number go dey flagged.
